title: Guillouet d'Orvilliers, Le Moyne and Morisse (Cayenne) to the Navy minister, ciphered letters 1751 and 1757-62 (ANOM COL C14 21, 24, 25)

documents.shelfmark: Archives nationales d'outre-mer, COL C14 21, 24, 25 (36 items listed in letters.tsv)

plaintext.source: The ANOM inventory notes no decipherment; several items are marked 'non traduit'. The letters have not been seen.

transcription.notes: Not digitised online: none of the 227 ANOM notices in the 1757-63 branch, nor the 1751 C14 21 notice, carries a digital object (27 Oct 2026). Nothing transcribed. French expected.

system.summary: unknown: the letters have not been seen.
system.notes: symbol_kind and key_order are placeholders: the schema has no 'unknown' value for them. The contemporary Martinique code (catalogue 542, mercier1761) was a numerical two-part nomenclator; whether Cayenne used the same kind is unknown.

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input.
tools: ANOM and FranceArchives in the built-in browser

solution.what: All 227 ANOM notices of the d'Orvilliers 1757-63 branch and the cited FranceArchives records read: 35 items with ciphered text in C14 24-25 plus the 1751 C14 21 letter (letters.tsv); none carries a digital object. 'Autres fonds numérisés' search shows no Guyane C14. Not digitised online.
DECODE harvest list (10,106 records) searched for Cayenne, Guyane, Guiana, d'Orvilliers, Le Moyne, C14: no record.
Web search on the shelfmark, correspondents, date and 'lettre chiffrée': biography and inventory pages only; no edition or decipherment.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: the items could not be reached online. Reproductions must be ordered from ANOM; key lead AN MAR/G/178, crib lead COL B outgoing dépêches.
